# Hand-added contacts free

`S3.3` · Coding rule

Hand-added contacts are free on every surface; credits only for provider unlocks: 2 credits paid provider contact (Cognism etc.), 1 credit Claude/biz ("free contact" class)

Defined in [[brain/context/conventions-shared|Rules for all code]].
